pages.text: The Heart of the Nether drops $(item)Abyssal Shards$() and an $(item)Abyssal Upgrade Template$(). At a Smithing Table, template + Onyx armor piece + shard = Abyssal piece, the strongest armor of the mod.$(br2)$(l)Full set$(): permanent Fire Resistance, Resistance, Strength in the Nether and immunity to Wither.
pages.title: Armure abyssale

pages.text: Duplicate it with 7 Onyx Shards and 1 Abyssal Shard.
